input: Hi, writing for our Executive Chef at a five-star Marina Bay hotel. For our festive champagne brunch, four Sundays from late November (about 250 covers), we need cold-water crab: roughly 60 kg per Sunday, 240 kg total, with whole crabs for the chilled display centrepiece plus leg/claw sections for a hot butter-garlic dish. Chef wants peak freshness guests can see, the calibre top Hong Kong and Tokyo hotels serve, as if straight from cold water to our station. Requirements: SFA-licensed importer with full cold-chain and origin papers, stock at our loading bay by 12:00 each Saturday, around SGD 145–175/kg landed. Please sign with the best supplier this week. Thanks.

experiences.name: Nordkapp Fjord Red King Crab, Landing-Stunned
experiences.description: Norwegian red king crab from Finnmark, the same origin top Asian hotels feature. Each crab is pot-caught, electrically stunned at the Finnmark landing plant on the day it is landed, then cooked in seawater, brine-frozen and glazed; no live transport or tank holding. Sea-freighted frozen to Singapore and held at −25 °C in an SFA-licensed cold store. Supplied as whole display crabs plus leg and claw sections, 60 kg by freezer van each Saturday before noon, with origin and cold-chain records.

experiences.name: Arctic Crown Live Norwegian Red King Crab
experiences.description: Norway's prized red king crab, the showpiece of leading Asian hotel buffets. Pot-caught in Finnmark and graded 2.0–3.5 kg, the crabs travel live by air, out of water and chilled, for about 20–26 hours door to door, then are kept in our seawater holding tanks for up to 5 days. Delivered live in insulated crates by refrigerated van, 60 kg each Saturday before noon, for your kitchen to cook whole or split into legs and claws. SFA import permit, health certificate, origin and cold-chain records supplied per batch.

experiences.name: Rempah Lane Crab Station Accompaniments
experiences.description: Complete accompaniments for a brunch crab station serving 250 covers per Sunday: house chilli sambal made without belacan, calamansi-lime and yuzu dressings, egg- and dairy-free fried mantou, fresh herb salads and pickled cucumber. Prepared by our central kitchen in Woodlands and delivered chilled on Saturday morning in reusable gastronorm trays, labelled and ready to plate.

experiences.name: Bering Gold Sea-Stunned Red King Crab
experiences.description: Bering Sea red king crab, cooked and frozen at sea aboard a catcher-processor vessel. Each crab is electrically stunned on board within one hour of hauling, then cooked in seawater brine, brine-frozen and glazed at −35 °C; no live transport or tank holding. Whole crabs of 2.0–3.5 kg anchor the display, with leg and claw sections for hot service. Shipped frozen to our Singapore cold store and delivered by freezer van, 60 kg each Saturday before noon, tempered on request. SFA-licensed, with origin and cold-chain records.

experiences.name: Southern Deep Live Tasmanian Giant Crab
experiences.description: Tasmania's rare giant crab, with brick-red shells and heavy claws built for a showpiece display. Caught by licensed deep-water pot fishers off western Tasmania, 3–6 kg per crab, flown live from Hobart out of water in chilled damp packing for about 15–20 hours door to door, then kept in our seawater holding tanks for up to 7 days. Delivered live by refrigerated van, 60 kg each Saturday before noon, for whole display or claw portions. Australian export health certificate, SFA permit, origin and cold-chain records supplied.

experiences.name: Frostline Ice & Buffet Display Hire
experiences.description: Make the seafood counter the focal point of the room. The package includes stainless-steel ice-bed counters with meltwater drainage, a carved ice centrepiece and chafing stations for hot dishes. Ice is carved in our Tuas workshop on Saturday; a crew of two sets up from 08:00 Sunday and dismantles after service. Priced per Sunday, with multi-week bookings available.

experiences.name: Verdant Table Plant-Based Brunch Station
experiences.description: A premium plant-based station for 250 covers: grilled king oyster mushroom 'scallops', charred corn with a chilli butter-style vegan glaze, and a chilled konjac-and-seaweed 'crab' salad. Produced by our Singapore kitchen using Malaysian-grown mushrooms, delivered chilled on Saturday and finished on site by your hotel chefs.
